title: Kairos Campus conceptual visualization inventory

statusLegend.CONFIRMED: Function, room or relationship explicitly established.
statusLegend.CONFIRMED_FUNCTION_LAYOUT_TBD: Existence or purpose confirmed; physical configuration unknown.
statusLegend.PROPOSED_VISUALIZATION: Geometry or placement chosen only to produce a coherent model.
statusLegend.PLANNED_NOT_BUILT: Future idea without an established completed structure.

note: layout_is_proposed is true for every area: no floor plan, dimension or placement is canon. Status describes the FUNCTION only.
